title: Etho's Echo Shards
description:
Bats drop Echo Shards.

Etho's "Minecraft Idea of the Day" from his LP, episode 590.
body:
## A Warden-free Recovery Compass Minecraft's default death mechanics can be frustrating. The recovery compass is a welcome aid for those adventures gone awry - **too bad you have to go into the most dangerous place in the game to get one...**\ **No more!** This data pack adds a loot table for bats so that they drop echo shards.\ Now you can echolocate your last death! Speaking of llamas, all credit for this idea goes to Etho:\ Etho Plays Minecraft - Episode 590: Big Green & Farm (Minecraft Idea of The Day)
Drop Rate: | Looting Level | Echo Shards | |:---------------------:|:---------------------:| | None (Default) | 0-1 | | Looting I | 0-2 | | Looting II | 0-3 | | Looting III | 0-4 | To give you a sense of the drop rate: The bat's loot table is an edited version of the enderman loot table.
